data.name: Khunays
data.gender_notes: Khunays is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A companion or friend, one who is close and dear. The name Khunays carries the meaning “Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khunays usually hope their child will grow to embody companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A friend of Allah, a companion in the afterlife.
data.etymology: Khunays belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khunays total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: خنيس
in_arabic.meaning: خنيس يعني الشخص الذي يملك قلبا قويا و ناصعا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خنيس مشتق من الجذر خ-ن-س، و يعني الشخص الذي يملك قلبا قويا و ناصعا، و يتصف بالشجاعة و الصبر. ورد اسم خنيس في بعض الأحاديث النبوية، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و العزيمة.

in_urdu.name: خنیس
in_urdu.meaning: خنیس یعنی وہ شخص جس کے پاس مضبوط دل ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام خنیس عربی جڑ خ-ن-س سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جس کے پاس مضبوط دل ہو اور جو بہادری اور صبر کی صفات رکھتا ہو. خنیس بعض نبی کریم ﷺ کے احادیث میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اور یہ ان ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو مضبوطی اور عزم کے معانیを持つ ہیں.

in_hindi.name: खनिस
in_hindi.meaning: खनिस का अर्थ है मजबूत दिल वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: खनिस नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल خ-ن-س से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत दिल वाला व्यक्ति और जो बहादुरी और धैर्य के गुणों से युक्त हो. खनिस नाम पैगंबर मुहम्मद ﷺ के कुछ बातों में उल्लेखित है, और यह उन नामों में से एक है जो शक्ति और संकल्प के अर्थ रखते हैं.

in_pashto.name: خنیس
in_pashto.meaning: خنیس د قوي زړه لرونکی سړی معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د خنیس نوم د عربي ريښې خ-ن-س څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چي معنی يې د قوي زړه لرونکی سړی دی او چي د زړورتیا او صبر ځانګړتیاوې لري. خنیس د نبي کريم ﷺ په ځينو احادیثو کي ياد دی، او دا د هغو نومونو څخه يو دی چي د قوت او عزم معنی لري.

in_english.name: Khunays
in_english.meaning: Strong-hearted person, brave and patient individual
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khunays is derived from the Arabic root خ-ن-س (kh-n-s), which signifies a person with a strong and pure heart. It connotes bravery, patience, and resilience. Historically, the name Khunays has been mentioned in some prophetic traditions, embodying qualities of strength and determination. In Islamic culture, the name is valued for its spiritual significance, reflecting a person's ability to face challenges with courage and steadfastness.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic society, the term "Khunays" is used to denote a close and trusted companion, friend or confidant. In a broader sense, it can refer to anyone who holds a special place in one's heart, offering support, guidance and camaraderie. People value such relationships and cherish them deeply, as they help to enrich our lives and provide us with a sense of belonging and connection.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Khunays" takes on a deeper meaning. It symbolizes the bond between the believer and Allah, reminding us of the crucial role that faith and devotion play in our lives. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is called "Khunas Associhim" or "Khunas As-Sari" in Arabic, meaning the "most beloved of slaves" or "the most intimate of friends," emphasizing the deep love and closeness that Allah has for His sincere servants. This spiritual significance serves as a reminder for us to strive to maintain a strong connection with Allah, and to seek companionship with Him above all else.
